name: 🌵 Southwest Black Bean & Egg Salad
tagline: Egg salad meets taco salad: chopped eggs, black beans, corn, salsa and a creamy lime dressing.

items.name: Bush's black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs: cover with cold water, bring to a boil, cover, turn off the heat and wait 10 minutes. Move to ice water.
Stir the yogurt, salsa, lime juice, cumin and salt into a dressing.
Fold in the eggs, beans and corn.
Dice the avocado and fold in right before eating.
Scoop with tortilla chips or serve in lettuce cups.

chef_tip: Greek yogurt plus salsa makes a dressing with all the creaminess of mayo, double the protein and a little zip.
make_ahead: Boil a dozen eggs on Sunday for this, snacks and Eggs & Apple Slices.
heads_up: Boil the eggs first (or use pre-boiled).
